intro: Never Saddle on Quality is an Alliance task centered at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. Handlers require pristine mountain leopard pelts to craft warm saddles for riding rams destined to reinforce the Alterac expedition. The effort ensures mounts and riders can endure the biting frost of the northern mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.
Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look chilly, adventurer. How goes the hunt?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, adventurer!
